Bloodline replaces non-scoring haste: 85 HP feeds the equipped Riftmaker HP-to-AP conversion. Keep conditional native modifiers separate from rune proc damage. Arcane Comet: Comet is separate damage and can miss; target movement and range affect the comparison. Coup de Grace: Eligible non-true damage only below 40% victim HP; not active on a healthy first hit.

No extra attacks are added to the scored action budget.
